metadata.case_name: YIP KAM HUNG BY HIS FATHER AND NEXT FRIEND YIP FUNG LOI v. LEUNG SAM NGA

plaintiff.occupation_after: daily worker at a poultry shop in Yaumatei

source: As a result of the accident he was rendered unconscious, suffered numerous lacerations to the eye-lids and his right eye ruptured.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration or rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: ruptured right eye was noted to be phthisical (shrunken)
source: Subsequently his ruptured right eye was noted to be phthisical (shrunken) and an artificial eye was fitted.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration or rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: total loss of vision in the right eye
source: As disclosed by Dr. William J. Heffernan's report dated 19th March 1987, there is a total loss of vision in the right eye.

manifestations.description: prosthesis ... too large causing it to have a large, immobile, staring appearance
loss of 3-dimensional vision with the disability to judge distance and depth
visual field defect i.e. narrowing of the field of vision

treatments_received: follow-up ophthalmic clinic visits (11 visits at Yaumatei Eye Clinic between February 1984 and November 1985)
treatments_future: replacement prosthesis (estimated cost $6,000; replacement every 8 to 10 years)

losses.description: Total loss of vision in the right eye.
Prosthesis is too large causing a large, immobile, staring appearance; lacerations to the eye-lids.
Handicap in the labour market / loss of earning capacity resulting from loss of an eye.

comparable_cases.case_name: Leung Nai Wing v. Hsing Kieng Shing
comparable_cases.injury_description: sustained multiple facial lacerations and loss of the right eye and the said award was agreed by the parties

comparable_cases.case_name: Young Wing Yin v. Motor Electric Manufacturing Co. Ltd.
comparable_cases.injury_description: 1 of his eyes was rendered virtually useless with the remaining eye having a 6/18 vision when best corrected due to high degree of corneal astigmatism. He had to stop work for 8 months.
